- BUGFIX: Don't try to obtain pieces info when no metadata is available (glassez) #25070
- BUGFIX: Add mnemonic for Plugins menu item (vafada) #25111

- BUGFIX: Fix unexpected drop behavior when dragging from Firefox on Windows (Chocobo1) #25140
- BUGFIX: Use system theme fallback icon for Open Destination Folder button (FTA7700) #25153

- BUGFIX: Save search session after restoring it (droplet-gag-saint) #25196
- BUGFIX: Allow renaming files with invalid names (droplet-gag-saint) #25197
- BUGFIX: Ensure that recently queued jobs are performed before shutdown (glassez) #25215
- BUGFIX: Adopt "producer-consumer" pattern in file-based resume data storage (glassez) #25217
- BUGFIX: Fix WebTorrent trackers are rejected from magnet links (glassez) #25259
- BUGFIX: Fix performance statistics time units (Chocobo1) #25277
- WEBUI: Preserve web seed URLs when editing (c8dhjp4tyv-bit) #25096
- WEBUI: Let search plugins download their own results (Piccirello) #25107

- WINDOWS: NSIS: Fix wrong registry view (Chocobo1) #25179
- WINDOWS: NSIS: Remove leftover registry value (Chocobo1) #25180
- MACOS: Add Homebrew prefix for Apple Silicon to PATH (MaxSiominDev) #25132

detail.readme:
# qBittorrent - A BitTorrent client in Qt

[![GitHub Actions CI Status](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/actions/workflows/ci_ubuntu.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/actions)

qBittorrent is a [BitTorrent] client programmed in C++ / Qt that uses
[libtorrent] (sometimes called libtorrent-rasterbar) by Arvid Norberg.

It aims to be a good alternative to all other BitTorrent clients
out there. qBittorrent is fast, stable and provides Unicode
support as well as many features.

The free [IP to Country Lite database] by [DB-IP] is used for resolving the countries of peers.
The database is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License].

[BitTorrent]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BitTorrent
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License]: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
[DB-IP]: https://db-ip.com/
[IP to Country Lite database]: https://db-ip.com/db/download/ip-to-country-lite
[libtorrent]: https://libtorrent.org/

## Installation

Refer to the [INSTALL] file.

[INSTALL]: INSTALL

## License

Refer to the [COPYING] file.

[COPYING]: COPYING

## PGP Public Key

Starting from v3.3.4 all source tarballs and binaries are signed. \
The key currently used is 4096R/[5B7CC9A2](https://pgp.mit.edu/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0x6E4A2D025B7CC9A2) with fingerprint `D8F3DA77AAC6741053599C136E4A2D025B7CC9A2`. \
You can also [download it](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/raw/master/5B7CC9A2.asc). \
**PREVIOUSLY** the following key was used to sign the v3.3.4 source tarballs and v3.3.4 Windows installer **only**: 4096R/[520EC6F6](https://pgp.mit.edu/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0xA1ACCAE4520EC6F6) with fingerprint `F4A5FD201B117B1C2AB590E2A1ACCAE4520EC6F6`.
